document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Through your watch, Norman lies quiet as a mannikin. You 
finally wake Sylvia and turn in. Sometime before dawn, a cry 
breaks your sleep. You raise your bleary head and peer across 
the campsite.
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 282.
